subject: Horizontal lines in the first page of the activity and sleep reports

messages.author: 03eb04d7756ff7c9
messages.subject: Horizontal lines in the first page of the activity and sleep reports
parts:
Hello, 

In the the first page of the activity and sleep reports, GGIR plots horizontal lines at 30 minutes, 25mg, 16 hours and 6 hours.

Does anyone known what do these values mean?

Thanks
Joan

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Horizontal lines in the first page of the activity and sleep reports
parts:
Hi Joan,
I choose them as quick reference points, people recommend 30 minutes of MVPA, and wearing the sensor for 2/3 of a day.
The other two thresholds were more random, maybe best interpreted as a visual aid to compare days.
None of the thresholds are evidence based, it is up to the user to look up literature to understand whether the values mean in the population you are studying.
Best, Vincent
